entities.summary:
Martin or Martinus was a Byzantine general of Thracian origin who served the Byzantine army during the reign of emperor Justinian I on various fronts.

He played a key role in several pivotal battles, including the reconquest of North Africa and Italy from the Vandals and Ostrogoths respectively, under the auspices of the Imperial Navy. This campaign marked a significant turning point in the Byzantine Empire's fortunes, as it reasserted control over vital trade routes and resources.

The military victories attributed to Martinus also underscored his reputation as a skilled tactician, earning him recognition from his contemporaries and subsequent historians alike.
